content:
Theo: deploybot aborted promote for release/2026-09-12 (commit 9f8e7d). Staging canaries failed with manifest/ETag mismatches when pulling image layers. tagging @renee @marco for triage.

deploybot: Promotion attempt at 3159990001 aborted. Reason: canary failures - layer digest/ETag mismatch. Candidate image: sha256:deadbeef. Job: ci/staging/canary#221. Snippet: 
- pull layer sha256:aa33 returned HTTP/1.1 200 but ETag: "etag-old-123" vs manifest digest sha256:aa33
Full logs: https://ci.internal/logs/ci-221 (internal).

Renee: curious - we saw a similar symptom last month where the CDN edge returned an old cached chunk while the origin had the new blob. Could be a stale index or missing cache invalidation after publish.

Marco: quick checks: 1) curl -I to the blob URL and compare ETag/Content-Length to `skopeo inspect --raw` manifest; 2) check CDN purge logs and origin access logs around the publish time. Trying HEAD now: 
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.internal/v2/app-server/blobs/sha256:aa33
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
ETag: "etag-old-123"
Content-Length: 8421034
```
But `skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.internal/app-server:ci-9f8e7d` shows layer sha256:aa33 size 8421034 and digest matches, so origin OK. Edge stale.

Theo: change window in ~50m. Product prefers avoid rollback, willing to accept a short delay to fix CDN if it's quick. What's ETA to purge/propagate?

Marco: CDN purge is usually <5m for manifests but edge propagation to all PoPs can be ~15-20m for some edge nodes. We can 1) purge CDN and re-run canaries, 2) promote while pinning to prev image (fast), or 3) attempt local reroute to origin bypassing CDN for canaries. My vote: purge + origin-bypass for canaries (fastest verification) then promote if green.

Renee: +1 for origin-bypass canaries. deploybot can run canaries with `--no-cdn` flag to hit registry origin directly. If canaries pass we can proceed without pinning. Set a hard cutoff of +25m. If still failing then pin to sha256:prod-20260901 and open INFR-4512.

Theo: agreed. @deploybot put promote on hold until 3159990151 (25m) with reason 'hold-cdn-purge-and-origin-bypass'. Notify product/support.

deploybot: Promotion placed on hold until 3159990151 per request 'hold-cdn-purge-and-origin-bypass'. Will auto-abort at cutoff.

Marco: issuing CDN purge for prefix `/v2/app-server/` now: `infra/cdn purge --prefix /v2/app-server/ --manifest ci-9f8e7d`. Also starting origin-bypass canaries: `deploybot canary --release release/2026-09-12 --count 2 --no-cdn`.

ci-bot: Purge job started at 3159990030. Purge completed for most PoPs at 3159990060; delayed PoP invalidations reported ongoing. Origin-bypass canaries started.

Renee: canary#1 (origin-bypass) passed. canary#2 passed. Running a quick smoke to be safe. Logs look clean, no digest mismatches.

Theo: smoke passed. Proceeding to promote to candidate image sha256:deadbeef. Command: `deploybot promote --release release/2026-09-12 --image sha256:deadbeef --reason "cdn-purge-origin-bypass-verified"`

deploybot: Promotion succeeded. prod now at sha256:deadbeef. Promotion timestamp: 3159990085.

Marco: opening INFR-4512 to track follow-ups: add a pre-promote CDN-edge HEAD check in deploybot that validates ETag/digest equality, add automatic origin-bypass canary flag if mismatch detected, and set CDN publish-time invalidation hooks. Assigning to Marco and Renee.

Renee: also recommend adding `Cache-Control: must-revalidate` and a short TTL for /v2/manifests during publish window to avoid stale-edge issues. I'll PR the publish headers change.

Theo: release note: "release/2026-09-12 briefly held due to CDN edge returning stale blob ETag; performed CDN purge and origin-bypass canaries; promoted after verification. See INFR-4512." Adding to the notes now.

Marco: thanks all. Closing the hold. :white_check_mark:
